name: ip
summary: Shows and configures network interfaces, addresses and routes.
description: The modern network configuration tool (iproute2 package), which replaces ifconfig and route. It is organized as objects followed by an action: ip addr show, ip link set, ip route add… Names can be shortened (ip a for ip addr). Its options are whole words with a single dash (-br, -c). Changes made with ip are lost on reboot.

options.description: Brief output: one line per interface (-brief).

example.output:
2: wlp2s0: …
    inet 192.168.1.42/24 brd 192.168.1.255 scope global dynamic wlp2s0
fe80::/64 dev wlp2s0 proto kernel metric 1024 pref medium

subcommands.name: addr
subcommands.description: The interfaces’ IP addresses (short forms: a, address).

subcommands.name: a
subcommands.description: Short for addr: the interfaces’ IP addresses.

subcommands.name: link
subcommands.description: The network interfaces themselves: state, MAC address, enabling (short form: l).

subcommands.name: route
subcommands.description: Routing table: which way packets go, default gateway (short form: r).

subcommands.name: neigh
subcommands.description: Neighbors on the local network (ARP table): IP ↔ MAC mapping.

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: Action and parameters: show, add, del, set dev eth0 up…

examples.output:
2: wlp2s0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 state UP
    link/ether 3c:a9:f4:12:ab:cd brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
    inet 192.168.1.42/24 brd 192.168.1.255 scope global dynamic wlp2s0

examples.explanation: One line per interface, in color: the most readable.
The routing table; the “default via” line gives the gateway.
examples.output:
default via 192.168.1.1 dev wlp2s0 proto dhcp metric 600
192.168.1.0/24 dev wlp2s0 proto kernel scope link src 192.168.1.42

examples.command: sudo ip link set eth0 down
examples.explanation: Disables the eth0 interface (up to enable it again).

examples.command: sudo ip addr add 192.168.1.50/24 dev eth0
examples.explanation: Adds an IP address to the interface, until the next reboot.

dangerNote: Disabling an interface or changing routes remotely (over SSH) can cut your own connection to the server.
